a.speaker: narrator
a.text: The lift doors open onto a wall of green. Crops tangle with luminous alien vines. The air is thick, sweet, and hard to breathe.

b.speaker: bolt
b.text: Ugh, spores. My filters are crying. Kai, your air is getting contaminated. There's a ruptured scrubber seal right by the lift.

c.speaker: narrator
c.name: Hazard
c.text: Bad air slowly drains Kai's health until the breach is sealed. Walk into the breach to seal it. It won't kill you, but it will leave you weak.

d.speaker: bolt
d.text: Also: plants. Everywhere. Some of them are looking at me.

a.speaker: bolt
a.text: An Intrusion Suite! Oh, this is good. This is SO good. Red security doors? Mine now. Robots? Also mine, for a little while.

b.speaker: narrator
b.name: New ability
b.text: BOLT learned HACK: turns a robot against its allies in battle, and cracks red security doors in the field.

a.speaker: kai
a.text: A plasma cutter. Now we're talking.

b.speaker: bolt
b.text: Careful where you point that thing. I'm not flammable, but I am extremely meltable.

c.speaker: narrator
c.name: New weapon
c.text: PLASMA CUTTER: thermal damage that sets Bloom creatures on fire. It also burns through Bloom-choked doors. You can swap weapons freely during battle.

a.speaker: narrator
a.text: The pump station is a cathedral of vines. At its heart something enormous uncoils: a knot of thorns, roots and flowers the size of a lifeboat.

b.speaker: bolt
b.text: That's the whole garden. The garden grew teeth! Kai, it's regrowing while we watch. Fire stops the regrowth. Burn it!

a.speaker: narrator
a.text: The Behemoth shrivels and blackens, collapsing into a mound of ash and seed pods.

b.speaker: bolt
b.text: Smells like burnt salad. Victory salad.

a.speaker: narrator
a.text: The grow-lamp power junction. The Bloom has fused itself into the switching gear. Rerouting the lamp grid to the lift means untangling it wire by wire.

b.speaker: bolt
b.text: Grow lamps down, lift up! The plants are going to be so mad at us.

done.speaker: narrator
done.text: Power is flowing to the lift. The grow lamps have dimmed.

off.speaker: bolt
off.text: No power. The grow lamps are hogging it all. We need to reroute the junction here in the pump station.

a.speaker: halcyon
a.text: Lift to Engineering ready. This lift only travels up. You will not be able to return to Hydroponics.

a.speaker: narrator
a.text: A woman in a lab coat is tangled in glowing vines, half buried in a flowerbed. Bloom spots trace her neck.

b.speaker: nair
b.name: Dr. Nair
b.text: Oh! A person. An actual person! I'm Priya. Dr. Nair. Botanist. Currently fertilizer.

c.speaker: nair
c.name: Dr. Nair
c.text: The infection is slow, but it's spreading. A dose of Anti-Spore Serum would stop it. And I can't cut myself free of these vines.

again.speaker: nair
again.name: Dr. Nair
again.text: Still here. Still fertilizer. Did you find a serum?

ask.speaker: nair
ask.name: Dr. Nair
ask.text: Please. I can make it to the lift shelter if I'm free.

choices.text: Use a serum and cut her free (1h 30m)
I can't spare the time. I'm sorry.

saved.speaker: nair
saved.name: Dr. Nair
saved.text: Thank you. Truly. Listen: the Bloom isn't a weed. It's organized. It gardens. It talks to itself in light.

saved2.speaker: nair
saved2.name: Dr. Nair
saved2.text: Take my field kits. I'll hold on in the lift shelter. Go.

leave.speaker: nair
leave.name: Dr. Nair
leave.text: I understand. I do. Go save the rest of us.
